items.title: A map of flat modules injective modulo the maximal ideal preserves content ideals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a map of flat modules over a local ring which is injective modulo the maximal ideal preserves the content ideal of an element. The proof first notes the easy inclusion and reduces to showing that the content ideal of the image is not strictly smaller, which it does by choosing a nonzero map from the quotient of the two candidate ideals to the residue field using Nakayama's lemma, observing that the element is not in the kernel of the induced map from the larger content ideal tensored with the module, and transferring the same non-vanishing to the target using the injectivity hypothesis modulo the maximal ideal.
